item.title: AudioPaper 0.1.6
item.description:
AudioPaper 0.1.6: a compact Mini Player

  • The Mini Player is smaller. Your desktop already shows the wallpaper, so the large copy of it is now optional: Show Artwork in the … menu (and the Window menu) brings it back.
  • It reads top to bottom: the song, with the playing app's icon and a note or a microphone; the strip of images, with the one on your desktop outlined; that image's credit; the controls.

item.title: AudioPaper 0.1.5
item.description:
AudioPaper 0.1.5: update settings

  • Settings → About now has Check for updates automatically and Download and install updates automatically, with when AudioPaper last checked and a Check Now button. Before, the only way to choose was the question on the second launch.

item.title: AudioPaper 0.1.4
item.description:
AudioPaper 0.1.4: Spotify

  • Spotify works now, alongside Apple Music, and a free account is enough. AudioPaper follows whichever player changed most recently; either can be switched off in Settings → Sources.
  • Podcasts: Settings → General → During podcasts chooses your own wallpaper (the default) or the episode's cover art. Podcasts never get fan art, and the Mini Player shows the episode's cover either way.
  • Ads are ignored. The last song's art stays up until the next song.
  • The Mini Player and menu show which app is playing, with its icon, and a note or a microphone for music or a podcast.

The first time, macOS may ask to let AudioPaper control Spotify; that lets it read what's playing at launch and the podcast covers.

item.title: AudioPaper 0.1.3
item.description:
AudioPaper 0.1.3

  • Automatic updates. AudioPaper can now update itself. Choose whether it checks automatically; Check for Updates… checks now.
  • A note on images: art is found on the internet automatically and may be mislabelled or unexpected. Next Image skips one.
